What an audit measures

Cups per zone

Sixteen cups set out while the sprinklers run. We weigh what each one catches and map the dry spots.

Pressure at every head

A gauge reading at each valve tells us which heads are misting and which are starving.

Run times from numbers

Your controller gets its own schedule built from the audit, not from a guess.

Meter test first, then zone by zone

  1. Meter test. We shut everything off and watch the meter. If it spins, there is a leak.
  2. Zone isolate. One zone at a time until the leak is found and marked.
  3. Fix and test. The part is replaced, the zone runs again, and we show you the reading.

Every repair we list and price is covered for one year, parts and labor. Sample
